value.rationale: The null-filiform Leibniz algebra is a canonical maximal-nilindex non-Lie object. At dimension exactly twice the characteristic the diagonal of every nonzero-scaling derivation has its first second zero, producing a new rank defect. Its precise smooth rational hypersurface and complete all-prime finite-field rank distribution measure a natural first modular geometry transition; this goes beyond parameterizing derivations.
